context: Two teens debrief a confessional school moment
purpose: Teach: いつのまにか/とどめ/解り/なおさら/気付く/且つ/はかる/躊躇

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、さっきの告白、いつのまにか全校に広まってるんだけど。
lines.en: Hey, that confession from earlier has somehow spread through the whole school already.
lines.style: Casual disbelief, leaning in conspiratorially with raised eyebrows

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで?俺、廊下で告ったのが間違いだったって今気付くわ。
lines.en: Seriously? I'm only just now realizing confessing in the hallway was a mistake.
lines.style: Sheepish groan with palm dragging down his face slowly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しかも返事が「考えさせて」でしょ?あれが完全にとどめだったよね。
lines.en: And on top of that her reply was 'let me think about it,' right? That was totally the finishing blow.
lines.style: Half-teasing, half-sympathetic, suppressing a laugh behind hand

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うるさいって。タイミングをはかるべきだったのは解りきってたんだけどさ。
lines.en: Shut up. I knew perfectly well I should've timed it better, you know.
lines.style: Defensive mumble, kicking at the ground while talking

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 観客がいたから、なおさら断りにくかったんだと思うよ、彼女も。
lines.en: Because there were onlookers, it must have been all the more difficult for her to turn you down too.
lines.style: Softer, genuinely thoughtful, head tilted in consideration

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: つまり、勇気且つ無謀ってこと?俺の人生って常にそれだわ。
lines.en: So you mean it was brave and also reckless? That basically sums up my whole life.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh, shaking his head with a wry smile

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 次は躊躇せず、二人きりのときにしなよ。それが正解。
lines.en: Next time, don't hesitate, do it when you're alone with her. That's the right move.
lines.style: Nudging his shoulder, voice warm and encouraging him gently

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 次があればな…って思ったけど、お前に言われると不思議と立ち直れる。
lines.en: If there even is a next time, I was thinking, but somehow when you say it I can bounce back.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude beneath the joking tone, small grateful smile
